newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Senate on Tuesday passed a bill empowering the central bank to give credits to two troubled private banks in a bid to help them redeeem small depositors.
* The lower Chamber of Deputies voted a draft law to turn the Private Ownership Funds into investments funds starting November 1 1996.
* Romanian Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu will held today a speach at the UNO General Assembly presenting Romania's efforts to integrgrate in the EU and NATO.
* Victor Ciorbea Bucharest's mayor presented a reports on the first 100 days since being appointed in the job. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
